whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.help: What changed in Quizmoo, newest first.

1_3_0.title: Shuffled questions
1_3_0.intro: Play the questions in a new order every game, and see bigger pictures on the phones.

sections.title: Random question order
items: Turn on Shuffle question order in a quiz's settings, or only for one game when you start it. Every game then plays the questions in a new order.
A round moves as one block with its questions, and its questions are mixed too. Switch on Keep question order in a round when its questions must stay in order.
The Shuffle button above the question list mixes the quiz for good. It asks first, and Undo puts the old order back.

sections.title: Bigger pictures on phones and the projector
items: On phones the question number, the round, the timer and the settings button share one slim bar at the top, so the question's picture fills the width, with every answer still on screen.
On the projector the question, its picture and all the answers always fit on one screen.
When you pause, players see a big Paused sign in the middle of their screen, and nothing on it moves.

1_2_0.title: Rounds
1_2_0.intro: Split a quiz into rounds, each with its own intro, rules and standings, and make quizzes of up to 200 questions.

sections.title: Rounds in your quizzes
items: Group questions into rounds, each with a title, info, a picture and a colour. Questions outside the rounds still work, for a warm-up or a bonus question.
Every round opens with an intro on the projector and the phones. It waits until you press Start round, or starts by itself after a few seconds; Hold stops the countdown.
The standings can follow every round by themselves, or come only when you show them. Answers can also be revealed at the end of a round instead of after each question.
Each round can have its own time, points and rules, such as no speed bonus in the bonus round. Your controls tell you when a round has rules of its own.
The lobby says how many rounds are coming, the question screens show the round, and the results group the questions by round.

sections.title: The editor
items: A round is one card in the question list: drag questions in and out, move a whole round, or fold rounds away.
Give questions a colour too, to find them at a glance. Only you see the colours.
Hide the phone preview with the eye button at the top, for more room for the list and the question.
Spreadsheets and Quizmoo files keep the rounds and the colours; the template shows an example round.

sections.title: Bigger quizzes
items: A quiz can now hold 200 questions in up to 50 rounds, and a long game stays as quick at the last question as at the first.

sections.title: The cow
items: Now and then the cow pulls a face or says something silly, and around special days it dresses up for the occasion.

1_1_0.title: The first public beta
1_1_0.intro: Quizmoo is online for friends and family. Here is what you can do as a host.

sections.title: Make quizzes
items: Seven question types: single and multiple choice, true or false, free text, number, poll and put in order, each with a picture if you like.
The editor saves as you type, shows each question in a phone preview and lists what still needs fixing.
Import questions from a spreadsheet (Excel, Google Sheets) or a Quizmoo file, and download any quiz to share it.
Themes, answer colours and symbols, or your own colours, and your logo and event name on the projector.

sections.title: Run games
items: Players join with the PIN or the QR code on any phone, no app or account needed. Up to 60 players.
Pause, add 30 seconds, skip a question, send a message to every phone, and show a question again or the standings at any time.
Schedule a game up to 30 days ahead and share its link; players can add it to their calendar.
Lock your screen during a game, so nobody reads the answers off your laptop.
"Play again" starts a new round with the same players in one tap.

sections.title: Play in teams
items: You set the teams, the players make them, or both; anyone can also play on their own next to the teams.
Each team answers its own way: the captain decides, a majority vote, or everyone counts.

sections.title: See the results
items: A summary with the podium and the easiest and hardest question, then every player's, team's and question's details, and a CSV export.
Results are kept for 90 days, then deleted.

sections.title: Your account
items: My settings: quick messages, your usual game settings, branding, password and screen lock code.
Download all your data or delete your account at any time.
Friends can ask for a host account on the home page; an admin approves it.

sections.title: Good to know
items: Quizmoo installs on a phone or laptop like an app.
Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us through Feedback in the menu.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains, as the GDPR requires, what Quizmoo stores about you, why, for how long, and what you can do about it. The short version: as little as possible, only to run the game, never sold, never used for advertising or tracking.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The controller of your data is the operator named above, a private individual running Quizmoo as a free hobby project. Write to the contact above with any question or request about your data.

sections.heading: If you play
items: The nickname you type, the avatar you pick and your team. Everyone in the game sees them: the host, the other players and the shared screen. Use a nickname, not your full name.
Your answers, how fast you gave them and your points, to score the game and show the results.
A random player code in your browser, so you get back into the game after a reload.
Nothing else: no account, e-mail address, phone number, location or IP address is stored.
paragraphs: Legal basis: taking part in the game you chose to join (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)), and the host's legitimate interest in looking back at the results of their event (Article 6(1)(f)).

sections.heading: If you host
items: Your username, and your password only as a one-way hash that nobody can turn back into the password.
When you last logged in (shown only to the admin, to see which accounts are still used), and which version of the terms you accepted and when (the record of our agreement).
Your logins: a random code per browser, stored as a hash, for up to {{sessionDays}} days.
Your quizzes, the pictures you upload, your settings, and the games you ran with their results.
Admins only, if they enter one: an e-mail address for notices about new sign-ups, used for nothing else and deleted when they remove it or stop being an admin.
paragraphs: Legal basis: the agreement to use the service, i.e. the terms of use (Article 6(1)(b)); for the last login, the record of the terms and the security measures, the legitimate interest in running the service safely (Article 6(1)(f)).

sections.heading: Pictures and quiz content
paragraphs: Hosts decide what goes into their quizzes. If a picture or a question shows or names someone, the host must be allowed to use it. To have something removed, ask the host or write to the contact above.

sections.heading: Security
items: The connection is encrypted (HTTPS), and passwords and login codes are stored only as hashes.
To stop password guessing and abuse, the server counts requests per network address for a minute, in memory only. Addresses are never written to the database or the logs.
The hosting provider may log network addresses for its own security, under its own privacy policy.
If a data breach puts your rights at risk, the operator reports it to the authority within 72 hours and tells the people affected where the law requires it.

sections.heading: How long
items: Finished games, with the players' nicknames and answers, are deleted {{days}} days after the game at the latest, and each host keeps at most their newest 200.
Games nobody finished are closed after 12 hours and then deleted like finished ones.
Pictures that no quiz, setting or game uses any more are deleted within two days.
Expired logins are deleted daily. A sign-up the admin does not approve within {{signupDays}} days is deleted.
A player's seat in the browser is removed when they leave the game, or after {{seatDays}} days.
Host accounts, with their quizzes and pictures, stay until the host or the admin deletes them.
The hosting provider's backups can hold deleted data for up to 30 days before they are overwritten.

sections.heading: Who else gets your data
paragraphs: Nobody, for their own purposes. The service runs at a hosting provider ({{hosting}}), which stores and processes the data only to run it, as a processor under its data processing terms. If the provider or its parent company is outside the EU/EEA, transfers rely on the safeguards the GDPR requires: an adequacy decision such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, or standard contractual clauses.

When an admin has entered an address for sign-up notices, those e-mails go out through an e-mail provider ({{mail}}), also as a processor. It receives the admin's address and the notice, which says only how many sign-ups are waiting.

There are no analytics, advertising or social media tools, and the app loads nothing from other sites. The Feedback link for hosts leads to GitHub, a separate service with its own privacy policy; using it is optional.

sections.heading: Your rights
items: Access: a copy of the data about you. Hosts: My settings → Account → Download my data.
Correction of data that is wrong.

Erasure. Hosts: delete your account on My settings → Account; games and quizzes can be deleted at any time. Players: ask the host or write to the contact above with the date of the game, its PIN and your nickname.
Restriction of processing, and objection to processing based on legitimate interest.
Portability: the download above is a machine-readable JSON file.
paragraphs: We answer within one month. As players have no account, we may ask for the game's date, PIN and your nickname to find your data, and never for more than that.

sections.heading: Complaints
paragraphs: You can complain to the Hungarian data protection authority: Nemzeti Adatvédelmi és Információszabadság Hatóság (NAIH), 1055 Budapest, Falk Miksa utca 9–11., ugyfelszolgalat@naih.hu, naih.hu. You can also turn to the authority where you live or work, or go to court. It helps if you write to the contact above first, so we can put it right.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Hosts must be at least {{age}} years old. Players need no account and give only a nickname; when children play, the host running the event makes sure their parents, school or organisers agree.

sections.heading: Automated decisions and changes
paragraphs: Quizmoo makes no decisions about you by automated means, apart from scoring the quiz you play.
When this notice changes, the date above changes. If a change affects what hosts agreed to, they are asked to accept the new terms at their next login.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply between you and the operator named above whenever you use Quizmoo here. They are short, please read them. Hosts accept them when they sign up; players accept them by joining a game.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Quizmoo is a free, non-commercial quiz game run as a hobby by a private individual. It has no paid plans and shows no ads. It is offered as it is: features can change, and the service can pause or stop, if possible with notice on this site.

sections.heading: Who can use it
items: Players join a game with its PIN and a nickname; they need no account.
Hosts need an account, must be at least {{age}} years old and use it themselves: one person per account, no sharing.
Sign-ups wait for the admin's approval. The admin may decline one without giving a reason.

sections.heading: Your account
items: Keep your password to yourself, and don't use it anywhere else.
If you think someone else used your account, change your password and log out your other devices on My settings, and tell the operator.
You can delete your account at any time on My settings → Account.

sections.heading: What you put in
items: You are responsible for your quizzes, pictures, team names and messages, and you must have the right to use them: your own work, licensed to you, or allowed by law.
Not allowed: anything illegal, hate speech, harassment, sexual content, content that sexualises minors, glorified violence, or other people's personal data without a legal basis.
No advertising, spam or links to harmful sites.
Nicknames must not be offensive or pretend to be someone else. Hosts can remove players from their games.
You keep the rights to what you create. You allow the operator to store and show it only as far as needed to run the service for you, for example on the screens and phones of your games.

sections.heading: Running an event
items: Tell the players before they join that their nicknames and answers appear on the shared screen.
When children play, make sure their parents, school or organisers agree.

sections.heading: Fair use
items: Don't attack, overload or probe the service, get around its limits, or use automated tools to join games or create accounts.
Limits keep it fair for everyone, for example 20 open games and 1,000 pictures per host.
Found a security problem? Report it privately to the contact, and don't use or publish it before it is fixed. Thank you!

sections.heading: When something goes wrong
items: The operator may remove content, or suspend or delete an account, that breaks these terms or the law; without notice when that is needed to prevent harm.
Keep your own copy of important quizzes: download them from the quiz list. There are backups, but losing data can't be ruled out entirely.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: The service is free and provided as it is, without any guarantee that it is available or fits a particular purpose. As far as the law allows, the operator is not liable for indirect damage or lost data. This does not limit liability for damage caused intentionally or by gross negligence, for harm to life, body or health, or for anything else the law (in particular Section 6:152 of the Hungarian Civil Code) does not allow to be excluded.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: The version and date are shown above. When the terms change in a way that matters, hosts are asked to accept the new version at their next login; until they do, they can still download their data or delete their account.

sections.heading: Law and disputes
paragraphs: Hungarian law applies. If you are a consumer living elsewhere in the EU, you keep the protection of your country's mandatory law. Please write to the contact above first: most problems can be solved that way.

cookies.title: Cookies and storage
cookies.intro: Quizmoo uses one cookie, for hosts who log in, and a few entries in your browser's storage, each needed for something you asked for. That is why it does not ask for consent: the ePrivacy Directive and Section 155(4) of the Hungarian Electronic Communications Act allow strictly necessary storage without it. No tracking, analytics or advertising cookies, and nothing from other sites.

items.session: Keeps you logged in. Page scripts can't read it, and it is sent only to this site over HTTPS. Up to 30 days, or until you log out. On a local network without HTTPS it is called quizmoo_session.
items.player: Your seat in a game (a random code, your nickname and avatar), so a reload brings you back. Removed when you leave the game, or after 2 days.
items.draft: What you filled in while waiting for a scheduled game. Removed when you join or leave.
items.dismissed: The host message you swiped away. Until you close the tab.
items.picksOpen: Whether your team's picks are open. Until you close the tab.
items.lang: Your language. Until you change it or clear your browser data.
items.mode: Light, dark or system look. Until you change it or clear your browser data.
items.notice: That you have seen the storage notice, so it does not come back.
items.hostToasts: Whether the host page shows short notes about players joining and leaving.
items.appCache: The app's own files (code, fonts, pictures), so it starts quickly and can be installed. No personal data.

cookies.remove: You can delete all of it in your browser's settings (site data for this address). You will be logged out, and a player loses their seat in a running game.

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.intro: Quizmoo here is a free, non-commercial hobby project of a private individual, not a business.
items: Quizzes, pictures and messages are created by their hosts, who are responsible for them.
To report illegal content or a security problem, write to the contact above.

problems.type: unknown question type. Use one of: {{words}}.
problems.question: write the question, at most 500 characters.
problems.answers: give 2 to 6 answers, at most 200 characters each.

correct.single: write the number of the right answer's column, e.g. 2.
correct.multiple: write the numbers of the right answers, e.g. 1, 3; each needs an answer in its column.
correct.text: at most 20 accepted answers of at most 100 characters, separated by |.

problems.time: seconds from 5 to 180, or leave it empty.
problems.points: a whole number from 0 to 5000, or leave it empty.
problems.tolerance: a number of 0 or more, or leave it empty.
problems.color: unknown colour. Use one of: {{colors}}, or leave it empty.
problems.empty: No questions in this file. Fill in at least one row below the header.
problems.tooMany: A quiz holds at most 200 questions. Split the file in two.

group.question: write the group's title, at most 120 characters.
group.answers: the group's info may be at most 500 characters.

problems.emptyGroup: no questions below it. Add at least one, or delete the row.
problems.tooManyGroups: A quiz holds at most 50 groups.

guide: QUIZMOO QUESTIONS: one question per row, below the header row. Save as CSV (UTF-8), then import it in Quizmoo under Quizzes > Import.
Rows starting with # are notes and are not imported; you may delete them. Keep the columns in this order and leave cells you don't need empty.

type: single (one right answer), multiple (several right answers), true-false, text (players type the answer), number (players type a number), poll (no right answer) or order (players put the answers in order).
question: the question itself, at most 500 characters.
answer 1 to answer 6: what players choose from, 2 to 6 answers of at most 200 characters (single, multiple, poll and order only). For order, write them in the right order; players see them shuffled.
correct, for single: the number of the right answer's column, e.g. 2
correct, for multiple: the numbers of all right answers, e.g. 1, 3
correct, for true-false: true or false
correct, for text: the accepted answers separated by |, e.g. Jupiter | planet Jupiter. Capitals and accents don't matter. Empty: you mark the answers right or wrong during the game.
correct, for number: the right number, e.g. 1848 or 3.5. For poll and order leave it empty.
time: seconds to answer, 5 to 180 (empty: 20). points: 0 to 5000 (empty: 1000). tolerance, for number only: answers this close also count, e.g. 10 (empty: exact).
colour: the question's or group's colour in the editor: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple or pink (empty: no colour).

group: starts a round. Write its title in the question column (at most 120 characters), its info in answer 1, and in time and points what its new questions get in the editor. The questions below it are in the group up to the next group or a group-end row.
Pictures, game settings and a group's own rules can't go in this file: add them in the editor after importing.
